title: Immanence of God
definition: The immanence of God means that the transcendent God is also near to and active within His creation.
summary: God is not distant from His creation but near, present, and active.
christFocus: Jesus is Immanuel, God with us, bringing the nearness of God to sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is exalted above creation, yet He is not absent from it. He is near, present, sustaining, ruling, hearing, and acting according to His will.

God's immanence comforts His people. He is near to the brokenhearted, near to those who call on Him, and present with His Church.

In Christ, God's nearness is revealed personally. The Son came as Immanuel, God with us.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people imagine God as far away and uninterested. The immanence of God matters because it assures believers that the Lord is near and involved.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Call on God with confidence. Remember His nearness in suffering, prayer, worship, and ordinary obedience.
